factor: omission of an optional theme argument
design: control has explicit theme, treatment drops exactly that theme; same predicate and same overt non-theme arguments. Four predicate blocks (pay/teach/serve/feed), analyzed per predicate AND aggregate; no single pooled mechanism claim across verbs.
theme_naturalness_note: the omitted theme is naturally recoverable in each block (money/wages, content, meal, feed); B does not claim one identical cross-verb mechanism
fund_note: fund unused for the minimal contrast (cannot drop its object); fund-specific money-implicitness stays a documented alternative observation, not primary material
gold: overt-theme items YES; dropped-theme items YES with expected CHECK
primary_metric: candidate_present overt vs dropped, per predicate block and aggregate

decision_rule.theme_support: dropped materially below overt, reproducing across predicate blocks
decision_rule.negative_result: theme omission does not systematically cause silence

material_shape: 4 verbs x 2 triples x YES/NO with deny = 16 sentences
test_material: built by script; validation + freeze below
